'''Jira's apartment''' was located in a narrow alleyway in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Its owner, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jira/Legends|Jira]], lived in extreme poverty and had few possessions which included a [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]], a ragged pillow, two shelves, and a couple of machines. Her apartment also lacked features typical of Tatooine settlements, such as a moisture seal or electronics in the [[Pourstone/Legends|pourstone]] walls. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Jira used her apartment to organise the [[Rescue of the Ghostlings|rescue]] of a group of [[Ghostling]] children with her fellow conspirators, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]], [[Dorn (Bothan)|Dorn]], and [[Pala Kwi'teksa]].<ref name="Episode I Adventures 6" />
